# AiYO Design System

> The AiYO Design System v2, "Minimalist Modern", is the AiYO brand theme for HeroUI v3 plus the page blocks and app patterns every AiYO product shares. Components come from `@heroui/react` (v3, built on React Aria) and are used directly, never copied or wrapped. One CSS file, `aiyo.css`, writes the AiYO palette into HeroUI's variables. The brand colour is Electric Blue #0052FF, named `accent` (HeroUI naming; there is no `primary` token). Type is Geist Sans for everything and Geist Mono for labels. Icons come from `@gravity-ui/icons`. AiYO blocks live in `src/components/aiyo/*`. DESIGN.md gives direction; the vendored antislop skills are the filter on top of it. Dials: ENERGY 2 / RHYTHM 2 / MOTION 2.

Key rules for agents:

- For UI work: read DESIGN.md for direction, then the antislop core skill as the filter plus the skill for the task, and run its Delivery Gate before delivering.
- Use HeroUI components from `@heroui/react` with `onPress` / `onAction`, and ids (plus `textValue`) on collection items. Never restyle their colours or radii per page; theme changes go in aiyo.css.
- Use tokens (`bg-background`, `text-foreground`, `text-muted`, `bg-surface`, `bg-default`, `border-separator`, `text-accent`, `text-*-soft-foreground` for status text), never raw hex. One accent colour only.
- Geist only: `heading-hero` and `heading-section` for marketing headings, `label-caps` (Geist Mono 12px uppercase) for labels. Every marketing section opens with SectionHeader: a plain mono label (no pill, no dot) → H2 → muted lede.
- Container `max-w-6xl`, asymmetric grids, left-aligned copy. Landing pages need at least one inverted section: solid deep slate, no dot grids, no glows.
- Gradient only on one headline word (GradientText, 24px or larger), the one leading IconTile and one data highlight. HeroUI's three elevation levels only.
- Motion: `<Reveal>` for marketing entrances (once), HeroUI motion for controls, no endless decorative motion, prefers-reduced-motion respected. `data-arrow` only on the one primary CTA per screen. Backdrop blur only on the sticky navbar.
- WCAG AA in light and dark, visible focus everywhere, 44px touch targets (aiyo.css handles HeroUI controls).
- Numbers, testimonials, logos and pricing tiers use real data only; otherwise leave the section out. The showcase's sample content is a labelled exception.
- App pages (mandatory): `PageHeader` titles. Settings with 3+ sub-sections use `Tabs variant="secondary"` (vertical on md+), one Card per tab.
- Every list page: PageHeader with "Add <Thing>" → SearchField and filters → Table (row actions in a Dropdown; loading, error and empty states) → `DataPagination`, always shown, pageSize 10, reset to page 1 on search/filter/size change, server-side for API data.
- Add/edit in a Modal only for ≤6 fields in one section with no uploads; otherwise a dedicated page (PageHeader `back` → FormSection → FormActions). Delete always confirms in an AlertDialog with a danger button. The showcase's App patterns section (`#app-patterns`) runs all of this.

## Docs

- [DESIGN.md](./DESIGN.md): the canonical spec. Tokens (light, dark, inverted), the AiYO adjustments to HeroUI, typography, layout, HeroUI usage rules and recipes, AiYO blocks with props, motion, responsive rules, accessibility, do/don't, landing and dashboard page recipes, the mandatory app page rules, the anti-slop decision log (§14) and the v1 migration map (§15).
- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): short instructions for AI coding agents. How to install, the hard rules, the antislop routing, and a snippet to paste into a project's CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md.
- [aiyo.css](./aiyo.css): the theme file itself.

## HeroUI

- [HeroUI React llms.txt](https://heroui.com/react/llms.txt): HeroUI's own index, for component props and parts. Component pages are readable as Markdown at `https://heroui.com/en/docs/react/components/<name>.mdx`.

## Anti-slop skills

- [antislop](https://github.com/AiYOID/aiyo-design-system/tree/main/skills/antislop): the core filter (purpose test, liveliness dials, Delivery Gate). Vendored from https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop, release 3.2.21, MIT.
- [antislop-ui](https://github.com/AiYOID/aiyo-design-system/tree/main/skills/antislop-ui): the UI and visual skill (color, layout, components, decoration, motion).

## Tokens

- [aiyo.tokens.json](./aiyo.tokens.json): W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) for colour (light and dark), typography, radius, shadow and motion.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](./llms-full.txt): AGENTS.md, DESIGN.md and aiyo.css concatenated into one file, for loading the full context at once.
